results.content:
When asked in April 2025, Trump's first three months were rated at 61% approval by Oklahoman polltakers. Now in August 2026, Trump remains at 52% approval in Oklahoma.

Nationally, Trump has an unfavorable majority across all ages, education levels, genders, and races. Trump's only favorability among Civiqs' demographics is found in the 82% of Republicans who remain faithful to the president.

results.content:
The data comes from Civiqs’ rolling online tracking poll of 118,886 registered voters. A Newsweek analysis compares Trump’s approval rating on July 22, 2026, with where it stood on January 20, 2025, the first day of his second term, with net approval calculated as 'approve' minus 'disapprove.'

Nationally, Trump receives 38 percent approval and 57 percent disapproval, leaving him 19 points underwater overall.
